question: Which of the following events took place in the United Provinces in February, 1922?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chauri Chaura**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Chauri Chaura incident took place in the United Provinces in February 1922:
 
• Chauri Chaura, a small town in the Gorakhpur district of the United Provinces (now Uttar Pradesh) 
 
• A violent clash between Indian protesters and British police during the Non-cooperation movement 
 
• The police station was set on fire, killing many police officials, and hundreds of people were arrested.
 
• Gandhiji called off the Non-Cooperation Movement on February 12, 1922. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Khilafat Movement
 
 
• This movement took place from 1919 to 1924.
 
• It was the first time a large number of Sindhi pirs came together to oppose British policy. 
 
 
 
• Kakori Incident
 
 
• On August 9, a group of revolutionaries led by Ram Prasad Bismil robbed the Kakori Express, a train carrying government funds.
 
• The revolutionaries' goal was to obtain funds for their revolutionary activities against British rule
 
 
 
• Quit India Movement
 
 
• It was a nonviolent protest movement that took place in India from 1942–1943 to demand an end to British rule: 
 
• The movement was planned by Mahatma Gandhi and the Indian National Congress (Congress Party).
 
• It was a response to the British colonial rule that had been in place since the East India Company's territories were transferred to the Crown in 1858.
